questions.question: Which of the following correctly describe the Pictor Nebula? Select all that apply.

options.1: It is a cloud of gas
options.2: It is located about four thousand light-years from Earth
options.3: It is lit from within by young stars
options.4: It is a dense ball of old stars

questions.question: How do scientists observe the Pictor Nebula? Select all that apply.

options.1: With an optical telescope
options.2: By picking up red light emitted by the nebula
options.3: Using radio equipment that picks up regular pulses
options.4: By measuring how its mass varies over time

questions.question: What do astronomers study the Pictor Nebula to learn? Select all that apply.

options.1: How gravity pulls pockets of gas together
options.2: How gas clouds ignite into new stars
options.3: How gravitational waves ripple through a region of space
options.4: How black hole emissions change

options.3: The remains of a dying star that is studied to understand how new stars form
options.4: The remains of a dying star that is studied to understand gravitational waves

options.2: A globular pulsar — a cloud of gas lit by its own embedded young stars

options.4: An emission nebula — two stars in a close gravitational orbit

options.1: It is a cloud of gas

options.4: It is a dense ball of old stars

options.1: With an optical telescope
options.2: By picking up red light emitted by the nebula
options.3: Using radio equipment that picks up regular pulses
options.4: By measuring how its mass varies over time

options.1: How gravity pulls pockets of gas together
options.2: How gas clouds ignite into new stars
options.3: How gravitational waves ripple through a region of space
options.4: How black hole emissions change

options.2: A gas cloud lit by embedded young stars that is studied to understand gravitational waves
options.3: The remains of a dying star that is studied to understand how new stars form

options.2: A globular pulsar — a cloud of gas lit by its own embedded young stars
options.3: A globular pulsar — the collapsed core of an exploded massive star
options.4: An emission nebula — two stars in a close gravitational orbit

options.1: It is a cloud of gas
options.2: It is located about four thousand light-years from Earth
options.3: It is lit from within by young stars
options.4: It is a dense ball of old stars

questions.question: How do scientists observe the Pictor Nebula? Select all that apply.

options.1: With an optical telescope
options.2: By picking up red light emitted by the nebula
options.3: Using radio equipment that picks up regular pulses
options.4: By measuring how its mass varies over time

questions.question: What do astronomers study the Pictor Nebula to learn? Select all that apply.

options.1: How gravity pulls pockets of gas together
options.2: How gas clouds ignite into new stars
options.3: How gravitational waves ripple through a region of space
options.4: How black hole emissions change

questions.question: Which of the following correctly describes the Pictor Nebula? Select all that apply.

options.1: A gas cloud lit by embedded young stars that is studied to understand how new stars form
options.2: A gas cloud lit by embedded young stars that is studied to understand gravitational waves
options.3: The remains of a dying star that is studied to understand how new stars form
options.4: The remains of a dying star that is studied to understand gravitational waves

questions.question: Which of the following correctly identifies what the Pictor Nebula is? Select all that apply.

options.1: An emission nebula — a dense ball of old stars gravitationally bound together
options.2: A globular pulsar — a cloud of gas lit by its own embedded young stars
options.3: A globular pulsar — the collapsed core of an exploded massive star
options.4: An emission nebula — two stars in a close gravitational orbit

questions.question: Which of the following correctly describe the Pictor Nebula? Select all that apply.

options.1: It is a cloud of gas
options.2: It is located about four thousand light-years from Earth
options.3: It is lit from within by young stars
options.4: It is a dense ball of old stars

questions.question: How do scientists observe the Pictor Nebula? Select all that apply.

options.1: With an optical telescope
options.2: By picking up red light emitted by the nebula
options.3: Using radio equipment that picks up regular pulses
options.4: By measuring how its mass varies over time

questions.question: What do astronomers study the Pictor Nebula to learn? Select all that apply.

options.1: How gravity pulls pockets of gas together
options.2: How gas clouds ignite into new stars
options.3: How gravitational waves ripple through a region of space
options.4: How black hole emissions change

questions.question: Which of the following correctly describes the Pictor Nebula? Select all that apply.

options.1: A gas cloud lit by embedded young stars that is studied to understand how new stars form
options.2: A gas cloud lit by embedded young stars that is studied to understand gravitational waves
options.3: The remains of a dying star that is studied to understand how new stars form
options.4: The remains of a dying star that is studied to understand gravitational waves

questions.question: Which of the following correctly identifies what the Pictor Nebula is? Select all that apply.

options.1: An emission nebula — a dense ball of old stars gravitationally bound together
options.2: A globular pulsar — a cloud of gas lit by its own embedded young stars
options.3: A globular pulsar — the collapsed core of an exploded massive star
options.4: An emission nebula — two stars in a close gravitational orbit

questions.question: Which of the following correctly describe the Pictor Nebula? Select all that apply.

options.1: It is a cloud of gas

options.4: It is a dense ball of old stars

questions.question: How do scientists observe the Pictor Nebula? Select all that apply.

options.2: By picking up red light emitted by the nebula
options.3: Using radio equipment that picks up regular pulses
options.4: By measuring how its mass varies over time

questions.question: What do astronomers study the Pictor Nebula to learn? Select all that apply.

options.1: How gravity pulls pockets of gas together
options.2: How gas clouds ignite into new stars
options.3: How gravitational waves ripple through a region of space
options.4: How black hole emissions change

questions.question: Which of the following correctly describes the Pictor Nebula? Select all that apply.

options.4: The remains of a dying star that is studied to understand gravitational waves

options.1: An emission nebula — a dense ball of old stars gravitationally bound together
options.2: A globular pulsar — a cloud of gas lit by its own embedded young stars
options.3: A globular pulsar — the collapsed core of an exploded massive star
options.4: An emission nebula — two stars in a close gravitational orbit

questions.question: Which of the following correctly describe the Pictor Nebula? Select all that apply.

options.1: It is a cloud of gas
options.2: It is located about four thousand light-years from Earth
options.3: It is lit from within by young stars
options.4: It is a dense ball of old stars

questions.question: How do scientists observe the Pictor Nebula? Select all that apply.

options.1: With an optical telescope
options.2: By picking up red light emitted by the nebula
options.3: Using radio equipment that picks up regular pulses
options.4: By measuring how its mass varies over time

questions.question: What do astronomers study the Pictor Nebula to learn? Select all that apply.

options.1: How gravity pulls pockets of gas together
options.2: How gas clouds ignite into new stars
options.3: How gravitational waves ripple through a region of space
options.4: How black hole emissions change

questions.question: Which of the following correctly describes the Pictor Nebula? Select all that apply.

options.1: A gas cloud lit by embedded young stars that is studied to understand how new stars form
options.2: A gas cloud lit by embedded young stars that is studied to understand gravitational waves
options.3: The remains of a dying star that is studied to understand how new stars form
options.4: The remains of a dying star that is studied to understand gravitational waves

questions.question: Which of the following correctly identifies what the Pictor Nebula is? Select all that apply.

options.1: An emission nebula — a dense ball of old stars gravitationally bound together
options.2: A globular pulsar — a cloud of gas lit by its own embedded young stars
options.3: A globular pulsar — the collapsed core of an exploded massive star
options.4: An emission nebula — two stars in a close gravitational orbit

options.2: It can be made out of the wool of Grennock mountain sheep
options.3: It can be made out of the wool of any type of sheep
options.4: It can be made out of the wool of Cheshire mountain sheep

questions.question: Which of the following are true of how Bracklin is woven? Select all that apply.

options.1: Two threads lock around each other during weaving
options.2: The interlocking binds two layers of cloth together without any stitching
options.3: Three threads are braided together tightly
options.4: The layers are bound together afterward with hand-stitching

questions.question: How is bracklin made? Select all that apply.

options.1: Double-weft interlock weaving
options.2: Double-warp chain weaving
options.3: Cross-thread basket weaving
options.4: Single-strand satin weaving

questions.question: Which of the following correctly describes Bracklin?

options.1: An animal-based fiber used for winter carpets and ceremonial wall tapestries
options.2: An animal-based fiber used for summer garments and ceremonial robes
options.3: A plant-based fiber used for winter carpets and ceremonial wall tapestries
options.4: A plant-based fiber used for summer garments and ceremonial robes

questions.question: Which of the following correctly describes a feature of bracklin? Select all that apply.

options.1: It comes in shades ranging from warm ivory to ash grey
options.2: It comes in shades ranging from pale green to straw yellow
options.3: It is produced mainly for winter outerwear and ceremonial robes
options.4: It is produced mainly for summer clothing and decorative hangings

questions.question: Which of the following correctly describe the outer appearance of the Mirelon? Select all that apply.

options.1: The skin is a dark, nearly black shade of blue

options.3: The skin is a warm yellow color
options.4: The surface is smooth and glossy

options.2: The color of the flesh comes from a pigment called nivellin
options.3: The interior is a soft pale violet
options.4: The color of the flesh comes from a pigment called thornellin

questions.question: What is the botanical name of the Mirelon? Select all that apply.

options.2: Thyrsocarpus pallens
options.3: Spinofex arbens
options.4: Thyrsocarpus mirabilis

options.2: Does not continue ripening once harvested; grows below 500 feet
options.3: Continues ripening after harvest; grows above 900 feet
options.4: Continues ripening after harvest; grows below 500 feet
